newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LG Siltron opens new chip wafer plant.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LG Siltron opens new chip wafer plant.

text.p: South Korea's LG Siltron Inc, a subsidiary of LG Chemical, said on Wednesday its new computer chip wafer plant with an annual production capacity of 1.2 million wafers started operations.
The plant, which cost 140 billion won, raised the company's annual production capacity to 3.1 million wafers for 64-megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips, an LG Siltron statement said.
The statement said LG Siltron planned to invest another 200 billion won to expand the plant's capacity to 4.8 million wafers by 1999. It gave no other details.
